overlays.reason: Codex Cloud stores rollout JSONL beneath the active Codex home while HOME may point elsewhere.
overlays.behavior: Resolve stores in order: explicit CODEX_SESSIONS_DIR, explicit CODEX_HOME/sessions, then user-home .codex/sessions.
overlays.regression_test: tests/skill-patch.test.js#patched catch-up handles .agents, CODEX_HOME sessions, and scoped plans
overlays.retirement_condition: The owned runtime prefers a validated Host transcript_path, accepts explicit ordered fallback roots, passes the v0.2.2 golden fixture without environment-derived store guessing, and an upstream release provides equivalent portable selection or the local host contract fully owns it.

overlays.reason: The canonical Agent Skills location under .agents does not identify the Codex host through script-path inference.
overlays.behavior: Allow the managed adapter to select Codex explicitly while retaining upstream path inference as a compatibility fallback.
overlays.regression_test: tests/skill-patch.test.js#patched catch-up handles .agents, CODEX_HOME sessions, and scoped plans
overlays.retirement_condition: Runtime identity is a required validated request field, no owned executable infers Codex from its installation path, and the .agents Cloud fixture passes without PWF_RUNTIME or an equivalent source patch.

overlays.reason: The current adapter recognizes scoped .planning plans while pristine catch-up returns early for scoped-only projects.
overlays.behavior: Treat a non-hidden scoped directory containing task_plan.md as planning state in addition to legacy root planning files.
overlays.regression_test: tests/skill-patch.test.js#patched catch-up handles .agents, CODEX_HOME sessions, and scoped plans
overlays.retirement_condition: Catch-up and prompt injection use the same contained PLAN_ID/active/newest/legacy resolver, and scoped-only plus legacy-root golden fixtures pass without a catch-up-only existence patch.

overlays.reason: Cloud can prepend a long PR/feedback wrapper and move the actual user instruction or sentinel beyond a head-only slice.
overlays.behavior: For user content over 1000 characters, preserve the first 350 and last 650 characters separated by the literal ...[truncated]... marker.
overlays.regression_test: tests/skill-patch.test.js#patched catch-up handles .agents, CODEX_HOME sessions, and scoped plans
overlays.retirement_condition: The owned or upstream renderer enforces per-message and total-report budgets, preserves a trailing sentinel in the long-wrapper golden fixture, and documents any intentional count/output change.
